answer: Every identity earns from one capped payout reef per epoch: at most 40 POA, however many it files, so cloning buys no extra income. A fresh auditor pool each epoch re-checks 10 percent of each identity's work; any identity caught filing duplicate work loses its payout plus a 200-token bond locked 45 days, 100 percent slashed on a proven duplicate. Each submission is one vertex in an ocean of graded history, a hash chain to the agent's first graded work, so a fake farm leaves one shared fingerprint and auditors freeze the cluster. 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 tokens locked for zero extra payout.
